Disclosure: 302-2 Energy consumption outside of the organization
Omission - Explanation: DESFA uses the upstream and downstream categories and activities from the ‘GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Accounting and Reporting Standard’ for identifying relevant energy consumption outside of the organization. "Fuel and energy-related activities (other than fugitives)" category which constitutes 3,56% of Scope 3 emissions, is already included in GRI 302-1 (apart from fugitive emissions which are excluded from the scope). "Purchased goods and services", “Capital goods” and “Investments” constitute 94,46% of Scope 3 emissions and cannot be converted into "energy consumption outside the organization" due to the methodology used to calculate the emissions which is based on spent report. “Upstream transportation and distribution”, “business travel” and “employee commuted” are not reported under GRI 302-2 as they constitute 0,98% of the Scope 3 emissions and are deemed insignificant by the Company to proceed with the calculation.
